description: We're two students from Hsinchu High School. We absolutely love mapping and creating. One of us has created a walking route app, plus we both have experience coding web apps. For the Martian Map challenge, we would like to present NASA data in an intuitive and useful way for a Mars explorer. We would be happy to have a teammate who is passionate about any of the following: Mars Science, Geology, Data Visualisation, or Design. You can speak either English or Chinese.
